# wso2is_application_authorized_api (Resource)

Allows an application to request the scopes of an API resource. In the Console, this is the application's **API Authorization** tab. Use it for your own APIs (`wso2is_api_resource`) and for the server's management APIs. To find a management API, use the `wso2is_api_resource` data source. For example, you can allow an M2M application to call the user management API. To import, use the ID `<application_id>/<api_resource_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "wso2is_api_resource" "orders" {
  name       = "Orders API"
  identifier = "https://api.example.com/orders"
  scopes = [
    { name = "orders:read", display_name = "Read orders" },
    { name = "orders:write", display_name = "Change orders" },
  ]
}

resource "wso2is_application" "backend" {
  name = "Order Processor"
  oidc = {
    grant_types = ["client_credentials"]
  }
}

resource "wso2is_application_authorized_api" "orders" {
  application_id  = wso2is_application.backend.id
  api_resource_id = wso2is_api_resource.orders.id
  scopes          = ["orders:read", "orders:write"]
}

# Authorize a management API, for example SCIM user management.
data "wso2is_api_resource" "scim_users" {
  identifier = "/scim2/Users"
}

resource "wso2is_application_authorized_api" "user_management" {
  application_id  = wso2is_application.backend.id
  api_resource_id = data.wso2is_api_resource.scim_users.id
  scopes          = data.wso2is_api_resource.scim_users.scope_names
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_resource_id` (String) API resource ID.
- `application_id` (String) Application ID.
- `scopes` (Set of String) Scope names the application may request.

### Optional

- `authorization_details_types` (Set of String) Authorization details types the application may request. Changing them replaces the authorization.
- `policy_identifier` (String) The authorization policy. With `RBAC`, users get the scopes that their roles grant. With `No Policy`, every signed-in user gets the authorized scopes. The default is `RBAC`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<application_id>/<api_resource_id>`.
- `identifier` (String) Identifier of the API resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import wso2is_application_authorized_api.orders <application_id>/<api_resource_id>
```
